root.label: MAGA Inc. announces $10 million Texas Senate ad spending

events.label: MAGA Inc. announces $10 million Texas Senate ad spending

slots.name: Texas ad spending
slots.sentence: MAGA Inc., the president’s political organization with a nearly $400 million war chest, announced it is spending $10 million on television and digital advertisements in the Texas Senate race.

events.label: MAGA Inc. spending to support Ken Paxton

slots.name: support spending
slots.sentence: Trump’s MAGA Inc. super PAC has already spent $20 million to support Paxton, as some national Republicans like Cornyn have refused to help the scandal-ridden candidate with fundraising.
